svg.title: Orbit shapes, links and kaleidoscope
svg.desc: Press O to cycle four orbit shapes: Circle, Ellipse (a tilted, squashed circle), Flower (a rose curve with 2 to 5 petals) and Spiral (a radius that breathes in and out). Press L for constellation links between orbiters closer than 90 pixels, and K for a kaleidoscope that draws the scene 1, 2, 3, 4 or 6 times around the centre.
